decision_rule: Only engineering-authority decisions unresolvable from controlled evidence are listed. No proposed engineering value is supplied.

decisions.decision_required: Release one current executable joint ontology/crosswalk between four V7 families and six SR11 records.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: No controlled mapping identifies which records decompose a family and which are constraints or historical artifacts.
decisions.downstream_effect: Cannot instantiate the graph or calculate DOF deterministically.

decisions.decision_required: Release the current physical rigid-body decomposition and body-to-solid/body-to-frame mapping.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: 16 is BOM grain, claimed 32 is unsupported, 31 is historical logical grouping, and solid counts are not physical-body counts.

decisions.decision_required: Release machine-readable current frame transforms, origins, and exact local joint axes.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Global axes alone do not define local constraints; frames.json is empty.

decisions.decision_required: Release executable constraints, limits/end-stops, and lock/rebound transition semantics.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Current constraints are empty and current semantics are metadata only.
decisions.downstream_effect: No legal constraint formulation or state transition exists.

decisions.decision_required: Release an authorized initial state for the G2 scenario.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: No controlled numerical pose/orientation/q/velocity/angular velocity/state assignment exists.

decisions.decision_required: Release the G2 execution protocol and acceptance tolerances.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Only generic runtime qualification exists; no T-OCS protocol is authoritative.
decisions.downstream_effect: A later run would be unauditable and non-repeatable by definition.
